title: King Oliver's original band lineup in Chicago
summary: He lists the Oliver band as it first came to Chicago: Dodds brothers, Armstrong, Lil Armstrong, Dutrey, Bill Johnson.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: He had the willpower. He was in Charlotte than anybody ever seen to have a stroke and go in and come out. So as I said, Johnny Dot, Baby Dot, and Louis Armstrong, the King Oliver, and the fellow who played trombone with them, I can't think of his name. Lil Armstrong was on piano then when they first came here.
Dutre, or did you? And Dutre.
Bill Johnson was on the bass. And Johnny Dot, he was on drums. And that was about all of the combination then.
